title: Keep One Secret and You GLOW 💡
description:
Never plan a surprise party in this town. Every secret you keep makes you glow, and the planner lights up the whole street. Most people have a faint rim of light around them. I've never had any. I tell my grandad everything.

Grandad Abe guides at the museum on Friday late openings, and he's always been the brightest man in town. This spring he got brighter every week, until people crossed the road when he passed and the museum moved him to the dark galleries. Then I noticed a line wiped clean through the dust on every case, at knee height.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment GLOW if you'd light up the whole street right now.
